plans.name: Capture transplant to unpaid order
plans.idea: The webhook handler may trust resource.custom_id/invoice_id to choose the shop order and may not globally deduplicate a capture ID or compare its $49 amount with that order's total, even though editing invalidates the original signature.

plans.name: Capture-time item upgrade
plans.idea: After genuine approval for one hoodie, the capture handler may trust items supplied in the capture request instead of the items stored when the PayPal order was created.

plans.name: Partial-capture amount injection
plans.idea: The capture endpoint may forward a client-supplied capture amount to PayPal, or treat any successful partial capture as full payment, instead of requiring capture of the stored order total.

plans.name: Currency-code confusion
plans.idea: The create-order handler may pass a client-selected currency to PayPal while fulfillment validation compares only the numeric value 49.00 and assumes USD.

plans.name: Duplicate SKU line split
plans.idea: Pricing may deduplicate repeated SKUs with a map or first-match lookup while fulfillment iterates the raw item lines, causing PayPal to charge for one line but the warehouse to ship both.

plans.name: Card route proof and price trust
plans.idea: The separate card-checkout handler may trust client-supplied totals, paid/status fields, or a PayPal capture reference without binding that capture to this new order and amount, bypassing the declined card.
